events.description: Train Agility, his lowest skill (level 1), by running an agility course.
events.explanation: Agility is at level 1 while every other skill is at 10. The agility_course tool trains it directly. The bag is empty and he has no gear, so there is nothing to prepare. I found no saved location for a course. The tool walks to the course start itself, so I'm not sending him to a place I can't confirm. If it can't find a course, the first step will fail and the history will show it. Walking also gives a little Agility XP.
